question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 2, 4 and 4 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do thrice the same work, working together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of (2, 4, 4) = 4 units.

Efficiencies: A = 4 ÷ 2 = 2, B = 4 ÷ 4 = 1, C = 4 ÷ 4 = 1.

Combined efficiency = 2 + 1 + 1 = 4 units/day.

Time to finish the original work = Total work ÷ Combined efficiency = 4 ÷ 4 = 1 day.

Time to finish thrice the original work = 1 × 3 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**
